items.text: Improved vehicle handling: refined suspension, steering and grip; removed burnout/launch attempt; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock during handbrake.
Helicopter passenger seat weapons now have aim sway that scales with movement speed.
Fixed UI pooling issue for vehicles, reducing UI glitches related to vehicle pooling.
Livestock now have a water need and will drink from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes.
TC upkeep rate now scales with the number of authorized players: first 4 players add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, additional players add 4% each.
Random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible result.
Store UI drawer bug fixed; missing image paths now fallback correctly, restoring proper display of store items.
Arrow icons refreshed and fixed, correcting visual inconsistencies in the UI.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Vehicles
- Improved vehicle handling: refined suspension, steering and grip; removed burnout/launch attempt; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock during handbrake.
- Helicopter passenger seat weapons now have aim sway that scales with movement speed.
- Fixed UI pooling issue for vehicles, reducing UI glitches related to vehicle pooling.

### Animals
- Livestock now have a water need and will drink from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes.

### Tool Cupboard
- TC upkeep rate now scales with the number of authorized players: first 4 players add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, additional players add 4% each.

### Gameplay
- Random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible result.

### UI
- Store UI drawer bug fixed; missing image paths now fallback correctly, restoring proper display of store items.
- Arrow icons refreshed and fixed, correcting visual inconsistencies in the UI.

items.text: Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).
